V0 = 3565.939077141579 (the bottom disc gives no flux about the origin, the cone X.n = 10 sin 10 deg / tan 10 deg over its area, the top X.n = 15 / sqrt 1.09 over its area); the round removes 16.021667699147, (1/3) of the flux of the position through the boundary of the material the round removes: the round's surface as the ball's circles about the spine from contact to contact, the strips of the faces between the edge and the contact lines, each written out exactly and integrated by Gauss-Legendre quadrature (24 points a panel).
